Visit note | 2025-06-01 03:30 PM | Dr. Nusrat Jahan, General Medicine | Patient: Shahana Matubbar, 55, female. Mrs. Matubbar reports that she has been feeling very tired and experiencing a mild headache. She mentions that these symptoms started after a crowded bus journey from Tangail. She works as a sales representative and lives with her family in Dhaka. She has no known chronic illnesses. She denies any chest pain, shortness of breath, or joint aches. On examination: temperature 102.0°F, BP 119/75 mmHg, pulse 103 bpm, weight 51 kg. Chest is clear and abdomen is soft. Assessment: Viral fever. Plan: a prescription was issued. She was advised to drink plenty of fluids, rest at home for three days, and sponge with lukewarm water if the fever is high. Follow-up in 3 days if the fever does not settle.

Visit note | 2025-06-01 03:30 PM | Dr. Sabrina Chowdhury, Cardiology | Patient: Obaidul Awal, 55, male. Mr. Awal describes a heavy feeling in his chest that eases with rest within minutes, along with breathlessness on effort and chest tightness when walking fast or climbing. He first noticed these symptoms while climbing to a fourth-floor flat in Gulshan. He works as a hotel receptionist and has a busy daily schedule. He reports no previous medical history. He denies dizziness, palpitations, or leg swelling. On examination: BP 157/90 mmHg, pulse 91 bpm, weight 68 kg. Heart sounds are normal and lung fields are clear. Assessment: Stable angina. Plan: a prescription was issued. He was advised to avoid heavy exertion until review, walk 20 minutes daily on flat ground, and stop smoking. Follow-up in 2 weeks with an ECG and fasting lipid profile.
